rules.title: MongoDB $where / operator injection surface
rules.message: Passing request objects into Mongo queries enables operator injection.
rules.fix: Allowlist fields; cast types; never pass raw req.body into find().

rules.title: os.system / popen command sink
rules.message: os.system/popen run through a shell. Tainted strings become RCE.
rules.fix: Use subprocess with argv lists and shell=False.

rules.title: PHP unserialize
rules.message: unserialize on untrusted data enables object injection.
rules.fix: Use json_decode; never unserialize user input.

rules.title: Java ObjectInputStream deserialization
rules.message: Java native deserialization is a historic RCE class.
rules.fix: Prefer JSON; if required, use look-ahead allowlisting.

rules.title: JWT decode without verify
rules.message: Decoding JWTs without signature verification trusts attacker tokens.
rules.fix: Always verify with an explicit algorithm allowlist.

rules.title: GitHub personal access token pattern
rules.message: Looks like a GitHub token committed to source.
rules.fix: Revoke/rotate immediately; use secrets vault / Actions secrets.

rules.title: Slack token pattern
rules.message: Possible Slack API token in source.
rules.fix: Revoke and store in a secret manager.

rules.title: S3 public ACL / public-read
rules.message: Public bucket ACLs often leak data unintentionally.
rules.fix: Block public access; use signed URLs for intentional sharing.

rules.title: Tool runs shell from prompt/tool args
rules.message: Agent tools that shell out on model-chosen args are prompt-injection RCE.
rules.fix: Allowlist tools; structured args only; sandbox; human approval for mutate ops.
